children: Raytheon received an $8 billion maximum ceiling contract to modernize terminals at the Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center.
The defense contractor said Tuesday will help with developmental modernization, production restart services and technical studies at the Strategic Communications Terminals.
Work will be performed in Marlborough, Mass., and Largo, Fla. It is expected to be completed by Oct. 12, 2036.
The contract was a sole source acquisition. Funds of $800,000 are obligated at the time of the award.
